CustomField.description: Berger-Levrault Spain's HubSpot association type id for this association, overriding Association_Type_Id__c in that portal only. Set this when the id differs per portal - custom-object and USER_DEFINED label ids are generated per portal (look each up via GET /crm/v4/associations/{from}/{to}/labels). Leave blank for HUBSPOT_DEFINED ids, which are stable across portals and come from Association_Type_Id__c. Blank or 0 in both fields means the association is skipped for Berger-Levrault Spain (and dead-lettered) rather than asserted with an unknown type.
CustomField.label: Association Type Id (Spain)
